OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)

OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, pf, t, strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth, CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN strptime('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d') ELSE strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d') END AS end_date

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, pf, t,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS by,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS bm,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS bd,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) END AS ey,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) END AS em,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 14 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) END AS ed
WITH p, pf, t, ey - by - CASE WHEN em < bm OR (em = bm AND ed < bd) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age <= 78 OR p.current_team = 'Capitanes de Arecibo' OR (t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo' AND pf.tenure = 'latest') OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0 OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN DISTINCT p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
